description: This file is a shell script that provides internationalization support for Git by interfacing with gettext.sh or its alternatives. It defines environment variables, selects gettext schemes based on system availability, and provides wrapper functions for translation.

methods.name: eval_gettext
methods.description: A function for evaluating gettext translations, with different implementations depending on the gettext scheme used.

methods.name: gettextln
methods.description: A wrapper function that calls gettext and appends a newline.

methods.name: eval_gettextln
methods.description: A wrapper around eval_gettext that also appends a newline.
